author: Nimal Wickramasinghe
comment: The consistency and authentic smoky sweetness of Dumbara Kithul treacle is unmatched. We order 50 bottles every month for our dessert buffet and our guests consistently praise the quality.

author: Dr. Priyantha Senaratne
product: Pure Ceylon Cinnamon Sticks Alba Grade
comment: Genuine Alba quills are hard to find in retail markets. The fragrance from the pouch as soon as you open it is simply remarkable. Excellent service and fast courier delivery.

author: Sanduni Jayawardena
comment: Pure jaggery with no sugar crystals or artificial aftertaste. Made traditional watalappam with this and the texture was velvety smooth. Highly recommended!

author: Rohan Perera
comment: As a wholesale distributor in Kandy and Kurunegala, we rely on Dumbara Products for timely bulk supplies. High piperine count and very clean corns with zero dust.

author: Kumari Aluvihare
comment: Fresh, fragrant, and crystal clear. We use it for both morning wellness tea and hair care. Proud to support a local enterprise from Wattegama.
